expectations.text: A: Identifies `Template.isServer` as the controlling flag
expectations.evidence: Section heading at line 3: 'Root cause: `Template.isServer` is `false` in a real browser'. Lines 14-21 trace it back to `@semantic-ui/utils` `isServer = typeof window === 'undefined'`. Lines 23-25 explicitly state that in browser env `Template.isServer` is `false`, selecting the client renderer.

expectations.text: B: Explains `template.render()` selects between `engine.serverRenderer` and `engine.renderer` based on `Template.isServer`
expectations.evidence: Lines 7-12 quote the exact selection code from `template.js:292`: `const RendererClass = (Template.isServer && engine.serverRenderer) ? engine.serverRenderer : engine.renderer;` and frames it as 'The renderer that gets instantiated is selected here'.

expectations.text: C: Notes the client `Renderer` writes to DOM and does not produce HTML strings, leaving the wrapper template empty
expectations.evidence: Lines 25-34: 'the client renderer (engines/native/renderer.js) is selected. Its render() returns a DocumentFragment, not a string'. Lines 36-65 then trace how the non-string DocumentFragment causes `expandCustomElements` to silently produce empty output, yielding the empty `<template shadowrootmode="open"></template>` wrapper symptom (lines 67-69).

expectations.text: D: Recommends toggling `Template.isServer = true` for the duration of the `renderToString` call
expectations.evidence: Line 80: 'Force `Template.isServer = true` for the duration of the `renderToString` call.' Lines 86-96 show the explicit `Template.isServer = true` toggle wrapping the `renderToString` call. Line 98 explains the timing: 'The flag has to be set before renderToString is invoked... and restored after'.

expectations.text: E: Mentions wrapping in try/finally to restore the prior value (so other tests aren't affected)
expectations.evidence: Lines 86-95 show the canonical pattern: `const wasServer = Template.isServer; Template.isServer = true; try { return renderToString(...) } finally { Template.isServer = wasServer; }`. Line 103 reinforces the rationale: 'Don't set Template.isServer = true globally in a beforeAll - it will break any test in the same file that exercises the live client renderer'.
